```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(2025)

install_and_load <- function(packages) {
  for (pkg in packages) {
    if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
      message(paste("Installing package:", pkg))
      install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }
}

install_and_load(required_packages)
```

## SECTION 1: DATA LOADING AND PREPARATION
```{r section1, echo=TRUE}

setwd("data/")

sites <- read.csv("Sites.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
fire_history <- read.csv("FireHistory.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
visits <- read.csv("Visits.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
species_data <- read.csv("Data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat("Structure of Sites data:\n")
str(sites)
cat("\nStructure of Fire History data:\n")
str(fire_history)
cat("\nStructure of Visits data:\n")
str(visits)
cat("\nStructure of Species data:\n")
str(species_data)

```

### SECTION 1.1: PLOTTING PREP
```{r plot_setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Create figures directory if it doesn't exist

setwd("data/")

if (!dir.exists("figures")) {
  dir.create("figures")
  cat("Created 'figures/' directory for saving plots\n")
}

# Define a helper function to save plots consistently
save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 10, height = 6) {
  filepath <- file.path("figures", filename)
  ggsave(filepath, plot = plot_obj, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  cat("Saved:", filepath, "\n")
}

# Color palette (consistent with your theme)
custom_colors <- c("Wet" = "#1a9988", "Dry" = "#2c5aa0")
palette_diagnostic <- c("#2c5aa0", "#3d7bb8", "#1a9988", "#0d5c52")

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))

custom_gradient <- c("#e0f4f1", "#1a9988", "#0d5c52")
```

### SECTION 1.1: DATE CONVERSION AND VALIDATION
```{r section1.1, echo=TRUE}
cat("\n")

cat("SECTION 1.1: DATE CONVERSION AND VALIDATION\n")


# Convert date columns ONLY if they are still character type
if (is.character(fire_history$Ref_Fire)) {
  fire_history <- fire_history %>%
    mutate(
      Ref_Fire = dmy(Ref_Fire),
      Prv_Fire = dmy(Prv_Fire)
    )
  cat("Fire history dates converted from character to Date.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("Fire history dates already in Date format - skipping conversion.\n\n")
}

if (is.character(visits$Date)) {
  visits <- visits %>%
    mutate(Date = dmy(Date))
  cat("Visit dates converted from character to Date.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("Visit dates already in Date format - skipping conversion.\n\n")
}

# Validate conversions
cat("--- Date Conversion Validation ---\n\n")

ref_fire_na <- sum(is.na(fire_history$Ref_Fire))
prv_fire_na <- sum(is.na(fire_history$Prv_Fire))
visit_date_na <- sum(is.na(visits$Date))

cat("Parsing results:\n")
cat("  Ref_Fire: ", nrow(fire_history) - ref_fire_na, "/", nrow(fire_history), 
    " valid dates\n", sep = "")
cat("  Prv_Fire: ", nrow(fire_history) - prv_fire_na, "/", nrow(fire_history), 
    " valid dates (", prv_fire_na, " legitimately missing)\n", sep = "")
cat("  Visit Date: ", nrow(visits) - visit_date_na, "/", nrow(visits), 
    " valid dates\n\n", sep = "")

# Display date ranges
cat("--- Temporal Coverage ---\n\n")

cat("Reference Fire Events:\n")
cat("  Range: ", format(min(fire_history$Ref_Fire, na.rm = TRUE), "%d %b %Y"), 
    " to ", format(max(fire_history$Ref_Fire, na.rm = TRUE), "%d %b %Y"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  Note: Reference fires span historical prescribed burns and wildfires\n\n")

cat("Field Visits:\n")
cat("  Range: ", format(min(visits$Date, na.rm = TRUE), "%d %b %Y"), 
    " to ", format(max(visits$Date, na.rm = TRUE), "%d %b %Y"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  Span: ", round(as.numeric(difftime(max(visits$Date, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                           min(visits$Date, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                           units = "days")) / 365.25, 1), " years\n\n", sep = "")

# Critical observation: visits span BEFORE and AFTER fires
cat("--- Critical Temporal Structure ---\n\n")

visits_with_fire <- visits %>%
  left_join(fire_history %>% dplyr::select(Site, Ref_Fire), by = "Site")

pre_fire_visits <- sum(visits_with_fire$Date < visits_with_fire$Ref_Fire, na.rm = TRUE)
post_fire_visits <- sum(visits_with_fire$Date >= visits_with_fire$Ref_Fire, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Visit timing relative to Reference Fire:\n")
cat("  Pre-fire visits (baseline): ", pre_fire_visits, " (", 
    round(pre_fire_visits / nrow(visits) * 100, 1), "%)\n", sep = "")
cat("  Post-fire visits (recovery): ", post_fire_visits, " (", 
    round(post_fire_visits / nrow(visits) * 100, 1), "%)\n\n", sep = "")

cat("INTERPRETATION:\n")
cat("  Pre-fire visits provide BASELINE biodiversity measurements.\n")
cat("  These will appear as NEGATIVE values in TimeSinceFire.\n")
cat("  This is methodologically valuable - not an error.\n\n")
```

### SECTION 1.2: DATA MERGING WITH EXPLICIT JUSTIFICATION
```{r section1.2, echo=TRUE}

cat("SECTION 1.2: DATA MERGING STRATEGY\n")


cat("--- Merge Rationale ---\n\n")

cat("Data Structure:\n")
cat("  - Sites.csv: 36 unique sites with environmental characteristics\n")
cat("  - FireHistory.csv: 36 records (1:1 with sites) with fire dates\n")
cat("  - Visits.csv: 170 field visits (multiple visits per site over time)\n")
cat("  - Data.csv: 8136 species observations (multiple per visit)\n\n")

cat("Merge Strategy:\n")
cat("  Step 1: sites + fire_history -> sites_fire (1:1 merge by Site)\n")
cat("  Step 2: visits + sites_fire -> analysis_data (many:1 merge by Site)\n\n")

cat("Justification for LEFT JOIN:\n")
cat("  - Unit of analysis: Individual field VISITS (not sites, not species)\n")
cat("  - LEFT JOIN preserves all 170 visits even if site info were missing\n")
cat("  - Ensures no loss of response variable observations\n\n")

# Execute the merge
sites_fire <- sites %>%
  left_join(fire_history, by = "Site")

# Validate 1:1 merge
cat("--- Merge Validation: Sites + FireHistory ---\n\n")
cat("Expected: 36 rows (1:1 relationship)\n")
cat("Actual:   ", nrow(sites_fire), " rows\n", sep = "")
if (nrow(sites_fire) == nrow(sites)) {
  cat("Status:   PASSED - No unexpected duplication\n\n")
} else {
  cat("Status:   WARNING - Row count mismatch, check for duplicates\n\n")
}

# Main merge: visits to site characteristics
analysis_data <- visits %>%
  left_join(sites_fire, by = "Site") %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate time since reference fire (can be negative for pre-fire visits)
    TimeSinceFire = as.numeric(difftime(Date, Ref_Fire, units = "days")) / 365.25,
    
    # Calculate fire interval (time between previous and reference fire)
    FireInterval = as.numeric(difftime(Ref_Fire, Prv_Fire, units = "days")) / 365.25,
    
    # Extract region from site code prefix
    Region = case_when(
      str_detect(Site, "^NU") ~ "Nungar Plain (NSW)",
      str_detect(Site, "^BU") ~ "Buchan River (VIC)",
      str_detect(Site, "^ME") ~ "Merambego Ridge (NSW)",
      str_detect(Site, "^NA") ~ "Namadgi (ACT)",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    
    # Convert categorical variables to factors with explicit reference levels
    Type = factor(Type, levels = c("Dry", "Wet")),  # Dry as reference
    Grassy = factor(Grassy),
    Dominant = factor(Dominant),
    Aspect = factor(Aspect),
    Ref_Type = factor(Ref_Type),
    Prv_Type = factor(Prv_Type),
    Region = factor(Region),
    Site = as.factor(Site)
  )

# Validate many:1 merge
cat("--- Merge Validation: Visits + Sites_Fire ---\n\n")
cat("Expected: 170 rows (all visits preserved)\n")
cat("Actual:   ", nrow(analysis_data), " rows\n", sep = "")
if (nrow(analysis_data) == nrow(visits)) {
  cat("Status:   PASSED - All visits retained\n\n")
} else {
  cat("Status:   WARNING - Row count mismatch\n\n")
}

# Check for sites that didn't match
unmatched <- analysis_data %>% filter(is.na(Type)) %>% nrow()
cat("Unmatched visits (missing site info): ", unmatched, "\n\n", sep = "")
```


### SECTION 1.3: MISSING DATA ANALYSIS
```{r section1.3, echo=TRUE}

cat("SECTION 1.3: MISSING DATA ANALYSIS\n")


# Identify missing values
missing_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "N_Missing") %>%
  filter(N_Missing > 0) %>%
  mutate(Pct_Missing = round(N_Missing / nrow(analysis_data) * 100, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(N_Missing))

cat("Variables with Missing Values:\n\n")
print(as.data.frame(missing_summary))

cat("\n--- Missing Data Mechanism Analysis ---\n\n")

# Analyze the pattern
n_missing_prv <- sum(is.na(analysis_data$Prv_Fire))
n_sites_no_prv <- analysis_data %>% 
  filter(is.na(Prv_Fire)) %>% 
  pull(Site) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  length()

cat("Pattern Analysis:\n")
cat("  - ", n_missing_prv, " observations (", 
    round(n_missing_prv / nrow(analysis_data) * 100, 1), 
    "%) missing Prv_Fire, Prv_Type, and FireInterval\n", sep = "")
cat("  - These correspond to ", n_sites_no_prv, " unique sites\n\n", sep = "")

# Check if missingness relates to Type
missing_by_type <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    N_Missing = sum(is.na(Prv_Fire)),
    Pct_Missing = round(N_Missing / N * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Missing Previous Fire by Site Type:\n")
print(as.data.frame(missing_by_type))
```

```{r section1.3.1, echo=FALSE}
cat("\n")
cat("MISSING DATA MECHANISM DETERMINATION:\n\n")
cat("  Classification: MNAR (Missing Not At Random)\n\n")
cat("  Reasoning:\n")
cat("  - Missing Prv_Fire means NO RECORDED previous fire event\n")
cat("  - This is INFORMATIVE - it indicates sites with only ONE fire in history\n")
cat("  - The missingness IS the data: these sites have Fire_Cnt = 1\n\n")
```

```{r section1.3.2, echo=TRUE}
# Verify the relationship between missing Prv_Fire and Fire_Cnt
fire_cnt_check <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(Has_Prv_Fire = !is.na(Prv_Fire)) %>%
  group_by(Has_Prv_Fire) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Fire_Cnt = round(mean(Fire_Cnt), 2),
    Min_Fire_Cnt = min(Fire_Cnt),
    Max_Fire_Cnt = max(Fire_Cnt),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Validation - Fire Count by Previous Fire Status:\n")
print(as.data.frame(fire_cnt_check))
```

```{r section1.3.3, echo=FALSE}
cat("\n")
cat("  Confirmed: Sites with missing Prv_Fire have Fire_Cnt = 1\n")
cat("  These are first-time fire sites in the monitoring record.\n\n")

cat("IMPLICATION FOR ANALYSIS:\n")
cat("  - Do NOT impute Prv_Fire or FireInterval with arbitrary values\n")
cat("  - Create indicator variable: HasPreviousFire (Yes/No)\n")
cat("  - FireInterval analysis should be restricted to multi-fire sites\n")
cat("  - Or model FireInterval = 0 for first-fire sites (interpretable as no prior disturbance)\n\n")

```


### SECTION 1.4: TEMPORAL STRUCTURE VALIDATION
```{r section1.4, echo=TRUE}

cat("SECTION 1.4: TEMPORAL STRUCTURE OF THE DATA\n")

# Summarize TimeSinceFire distribution
time_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    N_Sites = n_distinct(Site),
    Min_Years = round(min(TimeSinceFire, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Max_Years = round(max(TimeSinceFire, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Mean_Years = round(mean(TimeSinceFire, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    N_PreFire = sum(TimeSinceFire < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    N_PostFire = sum(TimeSinceFire >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("TimeSinceFire Distribution by Site Type:\n\n")
print(as.data.frame(time_summary))
```

```{r section1.4.1, echo=FALSE}
cat("\n")
cat("KEY OBSERVATIONS:\n\n")

cat("1. NEGATIVE TimeSinceFire VALUES:\n")
cat("   - These are PRE-FIRE baseline visits (not errors)\n")
cat("   - Minimum: ~-7 years (visits occurred ~7 years before reference fire)\n")
cat("   - Methodologically valuable for understanding baseline biodiversity\n\n")

cat("2. UNEQUAL OBSERVATION WINDOWS:\n")
dry_max <- max(analysis_data$TimeSinceFire[analysis_data$Type == "Dry"], na.rm = TRUE)
wet_max <- max(analysis_data$TimeSinceFire[analysis_data$Type == "Wet"], na.rm = TRUE)
cat("   - Dry sites: maximum ", round(dry_max, 1), " years post-fire\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Wet sites: maximum ", round(wet_max, 1), " years post-fire\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Ratio: Wet sites observed ", round(wet_max / dry_max, 1), 
    "x longer than Dry sites\n\n", sep = "")

cat("   CAUTION: This asymmetry could bias visual comparisons of recovery patterns.\n")
cat("   Sensitivity analysis recommended within common time window.\n\n")

cat("3. LONGITUDINAL STRUCTURE:\n")
visits_per_site <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(N_Visits = n(), .groups = "drop")

cat("   - Visits per site: ", min(visits_per_site$N_Visits), " to ", 
    max(visits_per_site$N_Visits), "\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Mean visits per site: ", round(mean(visits_per_site$N_Visits), 1), "\n", sep = "")
cat("   - This repeated-measures structure requires mixed effects models\n")
cat("   - Observations within sites are NOT independent\n\n")

```

### SECTION 2.6: RESPONSE VARIABLE DIAGNOSTIC PLOTS
```{r fig_response_distribution1, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}

cat("FIGURE 2.6: Response Variable Distribution Analysis\n")


# Plot 2.6A: Histogram with density overlay
p_hist <- ggplot(analysis_data, aes(x = TotalSpecies)) +

geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), 
                 bins = 20, 
                 fill = "#2c5aa0", 
                 color = "white", 
                 alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_density(color = "#1a9988", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(analysis_data$TotalSpecies), 
             linetype = "dashed", color = "#0d5c52", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = mean(analysis_data$TotalSpecies) + 5, y = 0.045,
           label = paste("Mean =", round(mean(analysis_data$TotalSpecies), 1)),
           color = "#0d5c52", fontface = "bold") +
  labs(
    title = "2.6A Distribution of Species Richness (Response Variable)",
    subtitle = "Approximately normal distribution supports Gaussian modeling approach",
    x = "Total Species Count per Visit",
    y = "Density",
    caption = paste0("n = ", nrow(analysis_data), " observations | ",
                    "Mean = ", round(mean(analysis_data$TotalSpecies), 1), 
                    " | SD = ", round(sd(analysis_data$TotalSpecies), 1))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "italic", color = "grey40"))
print(p_hist)
```

```{r fig_response_distribution2, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
# Plot 2.6B: Distribution by Site Type

    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +

print(p_type_dist)
```


### Plot 2.6C: Variance vs Mean check (for overdispersion)
```{r fig_response_distribution3, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}

type_stats <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(TotalSpecies),
    Variance = var(TotalSpecies),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Ratio = Variance / Mean)

p_var_mean <- ggplot(type_stats, aes(x = Mean, y = Variance, color = Type)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("Ratio: ", round(Ratio, 2))), 
            vjust = -1.5, size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "2.6C. Variance-Mean Relationship",
    subtitle = "Points above diagonal indicate overdispersion (Var > Mean)",
    x = "Mean Species Count",
    y = "Variance",
    caption = "Dashed line: Var = Mean (Poisson assumption)"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(30, 50), ylim = c(30, 150)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "italic", color = "grey40"))
print(p_var_mean)
```

```{r fig_response_distribution4, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
save_plot(fig_response, "fig_2.6_response_distribution.png", width = 12, height = 10)
```

## SECTION 3: EXPLORATORY VISUALIZATIONS
```{r section3_sites, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}

# 3.1 Distribution of Sites by Type
p1_sites <- sites %>%
  count(Type, Dominant) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Type, y = n, fill = Dominant)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "GnBu") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Sites by Type and Dominant Species",
    subtitle = "Note: Wet and Dry sites differ in dominant eucalyptus composition",
    x = "Site Type",
    y = "Number of Sites",
    fill = "Dominant\nEucalyptus",
    caption = "Potential confounding: Type is not independent of Dominant species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(p1_sites)
```

Wet and Dry sites show distinct dominant species composition (Snowgum 
vs Peppermint), representing a potential confounding variable that should be 
considered when interpreting differential recovery rates.

### 3.2 Total Species Over Time by Site Type

### PRELIMINARY: Response Variable Examination
```{r presection4, echo=FALSE}

cat("PRELIMINARY: Examining Response Variable Distribution\n")


cat("Response Variable: TotalSpecies (count of species per visit)\n\n")

# Basic statistics
cat("Summary Statistics:\n")
cat("  Mean:     ", round(mean(analysis_data$TotalSpecies), 2), "\n")
cat("  Variance: ", round(var(analysis_data$TotalSpecies), 2), "\n")
cat("  Min:      ", min(analysis_data$TotalSpecies), "\n")
cat("  Max:      ", max(analysis_data$TotalSpecies), "\n\n")

# Variance to mean ratio
var_mean_ratio <- var(analysis_data$TotalSpecies) / mean(analysis_data$TotalSpecies)
cat("Variance/Mean Ratio:", round(var_mean_ratio, 2), "\n\n")

cat("PRELIMINARY ASSESSMENT:\n")
if (var_mean_ratio > 1.5) {
  cat("  - Variance (", round(var(analysis_data$TotalSpecies), 1), 
      ") >> Mean (", round(mean(analysis_data$TotalSpecies), 1), ")\n", sep = "")
  cat("  - This suggests overdispersion is likely\n")
  cat("  - Poisson assumption (Var = Mean) will probably be violated\n")
  cat("  - We proceed with Poisson as BASELINE to formally demonstrate this\n\n")
}

cat("MODEL SELECTION RATIONALE:\n")
cat("  1. Start with Poisson GLM (theoretical baseline for count data)\n")
cat("  2. Diagnose overdispersion formally\n")
cat("  3. If overdispersed: move to Negative Binomial\n")
cat("  4. Address non-independence: add random effects\n")
cat("  5. This diagnostic-driven approach documents our reasoning\n\n")
```


## SECTION 4: THE STATISTICAL EVOLUTION
A Diagnostic-Driven Approach to Model Building

```{r section4, echo=FALSE}

cat("SECTION 4: THE STATISTICAL EVOLUTION - From Theory to Practice\n")

```


## STAGE 1: Poisson GLM 

```{r section4.stage1, echo=FALSE}

cat("STAGE 1: Poisson GLM (Starting Point for Count Data)\n")


cat("WHY START HERE:\n")
cat("  - TotalSpecies is a count variable (non-negative integers: range 13-73)\n")
cat("  - Poisson GLM is the canonical model for count data\n")
cat("  - Key assumption: Variance = Mean (equidispersion)\n")
cat("  - We will CHECK this assumption via diagnostic testing\n\n")

model_stage1_poisson <- glm(
  TotalSpecies ~ TimeSinceFire * Type,
  data = analysis_data,
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

summary(model_stage1_poisson)

# DIAGNOSTIC: Check for overdispersion
cat("\n--- DIAGNOSTIC: Testing for Overdispersion ---\n\n")

check_overdispersion <- function(model) {
  rdf <- df.residual(model)
  rp <- residuals(model, type = "pearson")
  pearson_chisq <- sum(rp^2)
  dispersion_ratio <- pearson_chisq / rdf
  p_value <- pchisq(pearson_chisq, df = rdf, lower.tail = FALSE)
  
  cat("Pearson Chi-squared:", round(pearson_chisq, 2), "\n")
  cat("Residual df:", rdf, "\n")
  cat("Dispersion ratio:", round(dispersion_ratio, 2), "\n")
  cat("P-value:", format.pval(p_value), "\n\n")
  
  return(dispersion_ratio)
}

dispersion <- check_overdispersion(model_stage1_poisson)

if (dispersion > 1.5) {
  cat("DIAGNOSIS: OVERDISPERSION DETECTED\n")
  cat("  - Dispersion ratio =", round(dispersion, 2), "(should be near 1.0)\n")
  cat("  - Poisson assumption violated: Variance >> Mean\n")
  cat("  - NEXT STEP: Fit Negative Binomial to accommodate extra-Poisson variation\n\n")
}

aic_stage1 <- AIC(model_stage1_poisson)
cat("AIC (Poisson):", round(aic_stage1, 1), "\n\n")
```

## SECTION 4.1D: POISSON OVERDISPERSION DIAGNOSTIC
```{r fig_overdispersion1, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}

cat("FIGURE 4.1: Poisson Model Overdispersion Diagnostic\n")

# Get residuals from Poisson model (assumes model_stage1_poisson exists)
poisson_resid <- data.frame(
  fitted = fitted(model_stage1_poisson),
  pearson = residuals(model_stage1_poisson, type = "pearson"),
  deviance = residuals(model_stage1_poisson, type = "deviance"),
  response = residuals(model_stage1_poisson, type = "response"),
  observed = analysis_data$TotalSpecies
)
print(poisson_resid)
```

```{r fig_overdispersion2, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Plot 4.1A: Pearson residuals vs fitted
p_resid_fitted <- ggplot(poisson_resid, aes(x = fitted, y = pearson)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dotted", color = "#1a9988") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "#2c5aa0") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#0d5c52", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "4.1A. Pearson Residuals vs Fitted Values",
    subtitle = "Pattern indicates model misspecification; spread > 2 indicates overdispersion",
    x = "Fitted Values",
    y = "Pearson Residuals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
print(p_resid_fitted)
```


``` {r fig_overdispersion1.1, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Plot 4.1B: Observed vs Expected variance
var_check <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(fitted_bin = cut(fitted(model_stage1_poisson), breaks = 10)) %>%
  group_by(fitted_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_fitted = mean(fitted(model_stage1_poisson)[cur_group_rows()]),
    observed_var = var(TotalSpecies),
    expected_var = mean(fitted(model_stage1_poisson)[cur_group_rows()]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fitted_bin))

p_var_check <- ggplot(var_check, aes(x = expected_var, y = observed_var)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "#2c5aa0") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#1a9988", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "4.1B. Observed vs Expected Variance",
    subtitle = "Points above diagonal confirm overdispersion (Var > Mean)",
    x = "Expected Variance (= Mean under Poisson)",
    y = "Observed Variance",
    caption = "Dashed line: Poisson assumption (Var = Mean)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "italic", color = "grey40"))
print(p_var_check)
```

### 4.2: NEGATIVE BINOMIAL GLM (Fixing Overdispersion)
```{r section4.stage2, echo=TRUE}

cat("STAGE 2: Negative Binomial GLM (Fixing Overdispersion)\n")

model_stage2_nb <- glm.nb(
  TotalSpecies ~ TimeSinceFire * Type,
  data = analysis_data
)

cat("Model: TotalSpecies ~ NegBin(μ, θ)\n")
summary(model_stage2_nb)

cat("\n--- IMPROVEMENT CHECK ---\n\n")
aic_stage2 <- AIC(model_stage2_nb)
cat("AIC (Poisson):", round(aic_stage1, 1), "\n")
cat("AIC (Negative Binomial):", round(aic_stage2, 1), "\n")
cat("Improvement:", round(aic_stage1 - aic_stage2, 1), "points\n\n")

cat("Theta (dispersion parameter):", round(model_stage2_nb$theta, 2), "\n")
```


### 4.3: NEGATIVE BINOMIAL GLMM (Fixing Non-Independence)
```{r section4.stage3, echo=TRUE}

cat("STAGE 3: Negative Binomial GLMM (Fixing Non-Independence)\n")

model_stage3_nb_mixed <- glmer.nb(
  TotalSpecies ~ TimeSinceFire * Type + (1 | Site),
  data = analysis_data,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000))
)

cat("Model: log(E[TotalSpeciesᵢⱼ]) = β₀ + β₁·Time + β₂·TypeWet + β₃·(Time×TypeWet) + uⱼ\n")
cat("       where uⱼ ~ N(0, σ²ᵤ) are site-level random intercepts\n\n")
summary(model_stage3_nb_mixed)

aic_stage3 <- AIC(model_stage3_nb_mixed)
```



### STAGE 4.4: GAUSSIAN MIXED MODEL (Practical Validation)
```{r section4.stage4, echo=TRUE}

cat("STAGE 4: Gaussian Mixed Model (Practical Validation)\n")

model_stage4_gaussian <- lmer(
  TotalSpecies ~ TimeSinceFire * Type + (1 | Site),
  data = analysis_data
)

summary(model_stage4_gaussian)

# Compare with Negative Binomial
cat("\n--- ROBUSTNESS CHECK: NB vs Gaussian ---\n\n")
aic_stage4 <- AIC(model_stage4_gaussian)
cat("AIC (Negative Binomial GLMM):", round(aic_stage3, 1), "\n")
cat("AIC (Gaussian Mixed):", round(aic_stage4, 1), "\n")
cat("Difference:", round(abs(aic_stage3 - aic_stage4), 1), "points\n\n")

# Calculate ICC for Gaussian model
var_components <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_stage4_gaussian))
var_site_gauss <- var_components$vcov[1]
var_resid_gauss <- var_components$vcov[2]
icc_gauss <- var_site_gauss / (var_site_gauss + var_resid_gauss)

cat("VARIANCE COMPONENTS (Gaussian Model):\n")
cat("  Between-site variance (σ²ᵤ):", round(var_site_gauss, 2), "\n")
cat("  Within-site variance (σ²):", round(var_resid_gauss, 2), "\n")
cat("  ICC:", round(icc_gauss, 2), "\n")
cat("  Interpretation:", round(icc_gauss * 100, 0), "% of variance is between sites\n\n")

cat("CRITICAL FINDING: ICC =", round(icc_gauss, 2), "\n")

if (abs(aic_stage3 - aic_stage4) < 10) {
  cat("CONCLUSION: AICs are similar (Δ < 10)\n")
}

```


### 4.4.A CRITICAL STATISTICAL FINDINGS
```{r section4.stageA, echo=FALSE}
cat("4.4.A. CRITICAL STATISTICAL FINDINGS\n")

# Extract coefficients dynamically
model_coef <- summary(model_stage4_gaussian)$coefficients

# Extract p-values
p_time <- model_coef["TimeSinceFire", "Pr(>|t|)"]
p_type <- model_coef["TypeWet", "Pr(>|t|)"]
p_interaction <- model_coef["TimeSinceFire:TypeWet", "Pr(>|t|)"]
```

```{r section4.stageA2, echo=FALSE}
cat("Fixed Effects Significance:\n")
cat("  TimeSinceFire:        p =", round(p_time, 3), "\n")
cat("  TypeWet:              p =", round(p_type, 3), "\n")
cat("  TimeSinceFire:TypeWet p =", round(p_interaction, 3), "\n\n")

# Dynamic interpretation
if (p_interaction > 0.05) {
  cat("RESEARCH QUESTION RESULT: NULL FINDING\n\n")
  cat("The interaction term (TimeSinceFire:TypeWet) is NOT significant.\n")
  cat("This means we CANNOT conclude that wet sites recover faster than dry sites.\n\n")
  cat("Possible explanations:\n")
  n_sites <- n_distinct(analysis_data$Site)
  cat("  1. Insufficient statistical power (n =", n_sites, "sites, high ICC)\n")
  cat("  2. High between-site heterogeneity masks any true effect\n")
  cat("  3. No genuine difference in recovery rates exists\n")
  cat("  4. Unequal observation windows complicate detection\n\n")
} else {
  cat("RESEARCH QUESTION RESULT: SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENTIAL RECOVERY\n\n")
  cat("The interaction term IS significant - wet sites show different recovery rates.\n\n")
}
```


### 4.4.B. SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: Restricting to Common Time Window
```{r section4.stageB, echo=FALSE}

cat("4.4.B. SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: Restricting to Common Time Window\n")

# Calculate actual observation windows from data
dry_max <- max(analysis_data$TimeSinceFire[analysis_data$Type == "Dry"], na.rm = TRUE)
wet_max <- max(analysis_data$TimeSinceFire[analysis_data$Type == "Wet"], na.rm = TRUE)

cat("RATIONALE:\n")
cat("  Current analysis compares:\n")
cat("    - Dry sites: observed to max", round(dry_max, 1), "years post-fire\n")
cat("    - Wet sites: observed to max", round(wet_max, 1), "years post-fire\n")
cat("  This is NOT a fair comparison - wet slope estimated from extended range.\n\n")
```

```{r section4.stageB1, echo=FALSE}
# Restrict to common window: 0 to dry_max years post-fire
common_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(TimeSinceFire >= 0, TimeSinceFire <= dry_max)

cat("Data within common window (0 to", round(dry_max, 1), "years post-fire):\n\n")

common_summary <- common_data %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(
    N_obs = n(),
    N_sites = n_distinct(Site),
    Min_time = round(min(TimeSinceFire), 2),
    Max_time = round(max(TimeSinceFire), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(kable(common_summary, format = "simple"))
cat("\n")

# Fit model on restricted data
model_common <- lmer(
  TotalSpecies ~ TimeSinceFire * Type + (1 | Site),
  data = common_data
)

cat("\nModel Results (Common Window: 0-", round(dry_max, 1), " years post-fire):\n\n", sep = "")
summary(model_common)

# Extract coefficients for comparison
full_coef <- summary(model_stage4_gaussian)$coefficients
common_coef <- summary(model_common)$coefficients

full_p <- full_coef["TimeSinceFire:TypeWet", "Pr(>|t|)"]
common_p <- common_coef["TimeSinceFire:TypeWet", "Pr(>|t|)"]

cat("\n--- COMPARISON: Full Data vs Common Window ---\n\n")
cat("Interaction p-value:\n")
cat("  Full data (unbalanced):   p =", round(full_p, 3), "\n")
cat("  Common window (balanced): p =", round(common_p, 3), "\n\n")

if (common_p > 0.05 && full_p > 0.05) {
  cat("FINDING: Null result persists in balanced comparison.\n")
  cat("  The observation window imbalance does not explain the null finding.\n\n")
} else if (common_p < 0.05 && full_p > 0.05) {
  cat("FINDING: Result changes with balanced data - investigate further.\n\n")
}
```

### 4.4.C. POWER ANALYSIS: What Effect Size Can We Detect?

```{r section4.stage4C, echo=FALSE}


cat("4.C. POWER ANALYSIS: Detectable Effect Size\n")


# Extract from model (not hardcoded)
interaction_estimate <- fixef(model_stage4_gaussian)["TimeSinceFire:TypeWet"]
interaction_se <- summary(model_stage4_gaussian)$coefficients["TimeSinceFire:TypeWet", "Std. Error"]

# Calculate 95% CI
ci_lower <- interaction_estimate - 1.96 * interaction_se
ci_upper <- interaction_estimate + 1.96 * interaction_se

cat("Observed interaction effect:\n")
cat("  Estimate:", round(interaction_estimate, 3), "species/year differential\n")
cat("  Standard Error:", round(interaction_se, 3), "\n")
cat("  95% CI: [", round(ci_lower, 3), ", ", round(ci_upper, 3), "]\n\n", sep = "")

# Minimum detectable effect (MDE) at 80% power
# For t-test with alpha=0.05, power=0.80, need effect/SE ≈ 2.8
mde <- 2.8 * interaction_se

cat("Minimum Detectable Effect (80% power, α=0.05):\n")
cat("  MDE:", round(mde, 2), "species/year differential\n\n")

cat("INTERPRETATION:\n")
if (abs(interaction_estimate) < mde) {
  cat("  - Our observed effect (", round(interaction_estimate, 2), 
      ") is smaller than MDE (", round(mde, 2), ")\n", sep = "")
  cat("  - We lack power to detect effects smaller than", round(mde, 2), "species/year\n")
  cat("  - The null result may reflect insufficient power, not absence of effect\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  - Our observed effect exceeds MDE - power is adequate\n\n")
}

cat("PRACTICAL SIGNIFICANCE:\n")
cat("  - Over 5 years, MDE would mean", round(mde * 5, 1), "species difference\n")
cat("  - Over 10 years, MDE would mean", round(mde * 10, 1), "species difference\n")
cat("  - Effects smaller than this are undetectable with our sample size\n\n")
```


### 4.4.D. COVARIATE ADJUSTMENT: Controlling for Potential Confounders

```{r section4.stageD, echo=TRUE}

cat("4.D. COVARIATE ADJUSTMENT: Controlling for Potential Confounders\n")

# Calculate actual counts from data
dominant_by_type <- analysis_data %>%
  distinct(Site, Type, Dominant) %>%
  group_by(Type, Dominant) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(Type, desc(n))

# Find most common dominant for each type
wet_dominant <- dominant_by_type %>%
  filter(Type == "Wet") %>%
  slice(1)

dry_dominant <- dominant_by_type %>%
  filter(Type == "Dry") %>%
  slice(1)

n_wet_sites <- n_distinct(analysis_data$Site[analysis_data$Type == "Wet"])
n_dry_sites <- n_distinct(analysis_data$Site[analysis_data$Type == "Dry"])

cat("RATIONALE:\n")
cat("  Wet sites: predominantly ", as.character(wet_dominant$Dominant), 
    " (", wet_dominant$n, "/", n_wet_sites, " sites)\n", sep = "")
cat("  Dry sites: predominantly ", as.character(dry_dominant$Dominant), 
    " (", dry_dominant$n, "/", n_dry_sites, " sites)\n", sep = "")
cat("  Type effect could be confounded with Dominant species effect.\n\n")

# Model with Dominant species as covariate
model_adjusted <- lmer(
  TotalSpecies ~ TimeSinceFire * Type + Dominant + (1 | Site),
  data = analysis_data
)

cat("Model with Dominant Species Covariate:\n\n")
summary(model_adjusted)

# Extract coefficients for comparison
unadj_coef <- summary(model_stage4_gaussian)$coefficients
adj_coef <- summary(model_adjusted)$coefficients

unadj_est <- unadj_coef["TimeSinceFire:TypeWet", "Estimate"]
unadj_p <- unadj_coef["TimeSinceFire:TypeWet", "Pr(>|t|)"]
adj_est <- adj_coef["TimeSinceFire:TypeWet", "Estimate"]
adj_p <- adj_coef["TimeSinceFire:TypeWet", "Pr(>|t|)"]

cat("\n--- COMPARISON: Unadjusted vs Adjusted ---\n\n")
cat("Interaction (TimeSinceFire:TypeWet):\n")
cat("  Unadjusted: estimate =", round(unadj_est, 3), ", p =", round(unadj_p, 3), "\n")
cat("  Adjusted:   estimate =", round(adj_est, 3), ", p =", round(adj_p, 3), "\n\n")

# Calculate percent change
est_change <- abs(adj_est - unadj_est) / abs(unadj_est) * 100

cat("FINDING: Estimate changed by", round(est_change, 1), "%\n")
if (est_change < 10) {
  cat("  Dominant species does NOT appear to confound the Type effect.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  Potential confounding detected - interpret with caution.\n\n")
}

# Show Dominant species effects
cat("Dominant Species Effects:\n")
dominant_rows <- grep("Dominant", rownames(adj_coef))
if (length(dominant_rows) > 0) {
  dominant_table <- as.data.frame(round(adj_coef[dominant_rows, ], 3))
  print(kable(dominant_table, format = "simple"))
}
cat("\n")
```

### 4.E. SYNTHESIS: What Do The Sensitivity Analyses Tell Us?
```{r section4.stageE, echo=TRUE}

cat("4.E. SYNTHESIS: What Do The Sensitivity Analyses Tell Us?\n")

cat("QUESTION: Is the null finding INFORMATIVE or UNINFORMATIVE?\n\n")

cat("EVIDENCE SUMMARY:\n\n")

# All values computed dynamically
window_ratio <- round(wet_max / dry_max, 1)
n_sites_total <- n_distinct(analysis_data$Site)

cat("1. OBSERVATION WINDOW BIAS:\n")
cat("   - Wet sites observed", window_ratio, "x longer than Dry sites\n")
cat("   - Common window analysis: p =", round(common_p, 3), "\n")
if (common_p > 0.05) {
  cat("   - Null persists with balanced windows\n\n")
} else {
  cat("   - Result changes with balanced windows - bias detected\n\n")
}

cat("2. STATISTICAL POWER:\n")
cat("   - Only", n_sites_total, "sites (effective n due to ICC)\n")
cat("   - ICC =", round(icc_gauss, 2), "- high between-site variance\n")
cat("   - Minimum detectable effect:", round(mde, 2), "species/year\n")
cat("   - Observed effect:", round(interaction_estimate, 2), "species/year\n")
if (abs(interaction_estimate) < mde) {
  cat("   - UNDERPOWERED to detect observed effect size\n\n")
} else {
  cat("   - Adequate power for observed effect size\n\n")
}

cat("3. CONFOUNDING:\n")
cat("   - Type confounded with Dominant species\n")
cat("   - Adjustment changed estimate by", round(est_change, 1), "%\n")
if (est_change < 10) {
  cat("   - Confounding does NOT explain null finding\n\n")
} else {
  cat("   - Confounding may contribute to null finding\n\n")
}

cat("CONCLUSION:\n")
cat("   The null finding should be interpreted as UNINFORMATIVE because:\n")
cat("   - Limited statistical power (", n_sites_total, 
    " sites, ICC = ", round(icc_gauss, 2), ")\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Cannot detect effects smaller than", round(mde, 2), "species/year\n")
cat("   - We cannot conclude recovery rates ARE equal, only that\n")
cat("     we lack sufficient evidence to detect a difference.\n\n")

cat("NEXT STEPS:\n")
cat("   - Stage 5: Test for non-linear recovery patterns (GAM)\n")
cat("   - Stage 6: Test for heterogeneous recovery rates (random slopes)\n")
cat("   - These may reveal patterns missed by linear interaction model.\n\n")
```



### STAGE 4.5: GAM (Testing for Non-Linearity)
```{r section4.stage5, echo=FALSE}

cat("STAGE 5: GAM (Testing for Non-Linearity)\n")

cat("RATIONALE:\n")
cat("  - The null finding assumes LINEAR recovery over time\n")
cat("  - Recovery might be non-linear (rapid initial, then plateau)\n")
cat("  - GAM allows data to reveal the functional form\n\n")

model_stage5_gam <- gam(
  TotalSpecies ~ s(TimeSinceFire, by = Type, k = 5) + Type + s(Site, bs = "re"),
  data = analysis_data,
  method = "REML"
)

cat("Model: TotalSpeciesᵢⱼ = α + f_Dry(Time)·I(Dry) + f_Wet(Time)·I(Wet) + sⱼ + εᵢⱼ\n")
cat("       where f(·) are smooth functions estimated from data\n\n")
summary(model_stage5_gam)

aic_stage5 <- AIC(model_stage5_gam)

# Extract smooth terms for interpretation
gam_summary <- summary(model_stage5_gam)
smooth_table <- as.data.frame(gam_summary$s.table)

cat("\n--- DIAGNOSTIC: Effective Degrees of Freedom ---\n\n")
cat("Smooth terms:\n")
print(kable(round(smooth_table, 3), format = "simple"))

# Extract p-values for each smooth
p_dry_smooth <- smooth_table["s(TimeSinceFire):TypeDry", "p-value"]
p_wet_smooth <- smooth_table["s(TimeSinceFire):TypeWet", "p-value"]
edf_dry <- smooth_table["s(TimeSinceFire):TypeDry", "edf"]
edf_wet <- smooth_table["s(TimeSinceFire):TypeWet", "edf"]

cat("\nINTERPRETATION:\n\n")

cat("1. LINEARITY CHECK (edf values):\n")
cat("   - Dry sites edf =", round(edf_dry, 2), "\n")
cat("   - Wet sites edf =", round(edf_wet, 2), "\n")
if (edf_dry < 1.5 && edf_wet < 1.5) {
  cat("   - edf ≈ 1 for both: LINEAR relationships are adequate\n")
  cat("   - Non-linearity does NOT explain the null finding\n\n")
} else {
  cat("   - edf > 1.5 suggests non-linear patterns present\n\n")
}

cat("2. TIME EFFECT BY TYPE:\n")
cat("   - Dry sites: p =", round(p_dry_smooth, 3))
if (p_dry_smooth > 0.05) {
  cat(" (NOT significant)\n")
} else {
  cat(" (SIGNIFICANT)\n")
}
cat("   - Wet sites: p =", round(p_wet_smooth, 3))
if (p_wet_smooth > 0.05) {
  cat(" (NOT significant)\n\n")
} else {
  cat(" (SIGNIFICANT)\n\n")
}

# Key finding interpretation
if (p_wet_smooth < 0.05 && p_dry_smooth > 0.05) {
  cat("KEY FINDING:\n")
  cat("   Wet sites show a SIGNIFICANT time effect (p =", round(p_wet_smooth, 3), ")\n")
  cat("   Dry sites do NOT show a significant time effect (p =", round(p_dry_smooth, 3), ")\n\n")
  cat("   This suggests recovery IS occurring in wet sites but NOT in dry sites.\n")
  cat("   The interaction test may have missed this because it tests for\n")
  cat("   DIFFERENCE in slopes, not whether each slope differs from zero.\n\n")
} else if (p_wet_smooth < 0.05 && p_dry_smooth < 0.05) {
  cat("KEY FINDING: Both site types show significant time effects.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("KEY FINDING: Neither site type shows significant time effect.\n\n")
}
```

### SECTION 4.5D: GAM SMOOTH TERM DIAGNOSTICS

```{r fig_gam_diagnostics, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}

# Plot 4.5A: Smooth terms visualization with confidence intervals
# Create prediction data for each Type
pred_dry <- data.frame(

)

pred_wet <- data.frame(
  TimeSinceFire = seq(min(analysis_data$TimeSinceFire[analysis_data$Type == "Wet"]),
                      max(analysis_data$TimeSinceFire[analysis_data$Type == "Wet"]),
                      length.out = 100),
  Type = factor("Wet", levels = c("Dry", "Wet")),
  Site = factor(levels(analysis_data$Site)[1], levels = levels(analysis_data$Site))
)

# Get predictions with standard errors
pred_dry_se <- predict(model_stage5_gam, newdata = pred_dry, 
                        type = "response", se.fit = TRUE, exclude = "s(Site)")
pred_wet_se <- predict(model_stage5_gam, newdata = pred_wet, 
                        type = "response", se.fit = TRUE, exclude = "s(Site)")

pred_dry$fit <- pred_dry_se$fit
pred_dry$se <- pred_dry_se$se.fit
pred_dry$lower <- pred_dry$fit - 1.96 * pred_dry$se
pred_dry$upper <- pred_dry$fit + 1.96 * pred_dry$se

pred_wet$fit <- pred_wet_se$fit
pred_wet$se <- pred_wet_se$se.fit
pred_wet$lower <- pred_wet$fit - 1.96 * pred_wet$se
pred_wet$upper <- pred_wet$fit + 1.96 * pred_wet$se

gam_pred_all <- rbind(pred_dry, pred_wet)

p_gam_smooth <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = gam_pred_all, 
              aes(x = TimeSinceFire, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = Type),
              alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = gam_pred_all, 
            aes(x = TimeSinceFire, y = fit, color = Type), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = analysis_data, 
             aes(x = TimeSinceFire, y = TotalSpecies, color = Type), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "4.5A. GAM Smooth Terms with 95% Confidence Intervals",
    subtitle = paste0("Wet: p=", round(p_wet_smooth, 3), " (significant) | ",
                     "Dry: p=", round(p_dry_smooth, 3), " (not significant)"),
    x = "Years Since Fire",
    y = "Predicted Species Count",
    color = "Site Type",
    fill = "Site Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Plot 4.5B: GAM residuals
gam_resid <- data.frame(
  fitted = fitted(model_stage5_gam),
  residuals = residuals(model_stage5_gam),
  Type = analysis_data$Type,
  TimeSinceFire = analysis_data$TimeSinceFire
)

p_gam_resid <- ggplot(gam_resid, aes(x = fitted, y = residuals, color = Type)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "4.5B. GAM Residuals vs Fitted",
    subtitle = "Checking for remaining patterns",
    x = "Fitted Values",
    y = "Residuals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Plot 4.5C: EDF comparison
edf_data <- data.frame(
  Type = c("Dry", "Wet"),
  EDF = c(edf_dry, edf_wet),
  p_value = c(p_dry_smooth, p_wet_smooth)
)

p_edf <- ggplot(edf_data, aes(x = Type, y = EDF, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("edf = ", round(EDF, 2), "\np = ", round(p_value, 3))),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(edf_data$EDF) * 1.4)) +
  labs(
    title = "4.5C. Effective Degrees of Freedom",
    subtitle = "EDF near 1 = linear; EDF > 1 = non-linear",
    x = "Site Type",
    y = "Effective Degrees of Freedom",
    caption = "Dashed line: EDF = 1 (linear relationship)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "italic", color = "grey40"))

# Plot 4.5D: Basis functions visualization (conceptual)
p_gam_qq <- ggplot(gam_resid, aes(sample = residuals)) +
  stat_qq(color = "#2c5aa0", alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_qq_line(color = "#1a9988", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "4.5D. Q-Q Plot of GAM Residuals",
    subtitle = "Checking normality of residuals",
    x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
    y = "Sample Quantiles"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

# Combine
fig_gam_diag <- (p_gam_smooth) / (p_gam_resid + p_edf + p_gam_qq) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.2, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Stage 5 Diagnostic: GAM Smooth Term Analysis",
    subtitle = "Key finding: Wet sites show significant time effect; Dry sites do not",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
  )

print(fig_gam_diag)
save_plot(fig_gam_diag, "fig_4.5_gam_diagnostics.png", width = 12, height = 12)

cat("  - Wet sites: SIGNIFICANT time effect (p =", round(p_wet_smooth, 3), ")\n")
cat("  - Dry sites: NOT significant time effect (p =", round(p_dry_smooth, 3), ")\n")
cat("  - This reveals recovery IS happening in wet sites but not detectable in dry\n\n")
```

STAGE 6: RANDOM SLOPES (Heterogeneous Recovery Rates)

```{r section4.stage6, echo=TRUE}

cat("STAGE 6: Random Slopes (Heterogeneous Recovery Rates)\n")


cat("RATIONALE:\n")
cat("  - Stage 4 assumes all sites within a Type recover at the SAME rate\n")
cat("  - Reality: individual sites may recover at DIFFERENT rates\n")
cat("  - Random slopes model allows site-specific recovery rates\n\n")

model_stage6_slopes <- lmer(
  TotalSpecies ~ TimeSinceFire * Type + (1 + TimeSinceFire | Site),
  data = analysis_data,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

cat("Model: TotalSpeciesᵢⱼ = β₀ + (β₁ + vⱼ)·Time + β₂·TypeWet + β₃·(Time×TypeWet) + uⱼ + εᵢⱼ\n")
cat("       where (uⱼ, vⱼ)' ~ N(0, Σ)\n\n")
summary(model_stage6_slopes)

aic_stage6 <- AIC(model_stage6_slopes)

# Likelihood ratio test
cat("\n--- DIAGNOSTIC: Is Random Slopes Improvement Significant? ---\n\n")
lrt <- anova(model_stage4_gaussian, model_stage6_slopes)
print(lrt)

lrt_pvalue <- lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]

cat("\n")
if (!is.na(lrt_pvalue) && lrt_pvalue < 0.05) {
  cat("CONCLUSION: Random slopes significantly improve fit (p =", round(lrt_pvalue, 3), ")\n\n")
  cat("IMPLICATIONS:\n")
  cat("  - Sites within each Type recover at DIFFERENT rates\n")
  cat("  - This heterogeneity reduces power to detect average Type difference\n")
  cat("  - The non-significant interaction may be due to this variability\n")
  cat("  - Some wet sites may recover faster, others slower than dry sites\n\n")
  
  # Extract variance components - FIXED METHOD
  vc <- VarCorr(model_stage6_slopes)
  slope_sd <- as.numeric(attr(vc$Site, "stddev")["TimeSinceFire"])
  
  # Get fixed effect for time
  time_effect <- fixef(model_stage6_slopes)["TimeSinceFire"]
  
  cat("VARIANCE IN RECOVERY RATES:\n")
  cat("  - Average recovery rate:", round(time_effect, 3), "species/year\n")
  cat("  - SD of site-specific rates:", round(slope_sd, 3), "species/year\n")
  cat("  - 95% of sites recover between:", 
      round(time_effect - 1.96*slope_sd, 2), "and", 
      round(time_effect + 1.96*slope_sd, 2), "species/year\n\n")
} else {
  cat("CONCLUSION: Random slopes do NOT significantly improve fit\n")
  cat("  Sites within each Type recover at similar rates.\n\n")
}
```

### STAGE 7: CROSS-VALIDATION FOR MODEL COMPARISON

```{r section4.stage7, echo=TRUE}

cat("STAGE 7: 10-Fold Cross-Validation\n")


set.seed(2025)

# Create 10 folds at the SITE level (not observation level)
sites_unique <- unique(analysis_data$Site)
n_sites <- length(sites_unique)
folds <- sample(rep(1:10, length.out = n_sites))
names(folds) <- sites_unique

# Add fold assignment to data
analysis_data$fold <- folds[as.character(analysis_data$Site)]

# Function to compute RMSE
cv_rmse <- function(model_formula, data, folds_col = "fold") {
  rmse_vals <- numeric(10)
  
  for (k in 1:10) {
    train_data <- data[data[[folds_col]] != k, ]
    test_data <- data[data[[folds_col]] == k, ]
    
    # Fit model on training data
    model <- tryCatch({
      lmer(model_formula, data = train_data)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(model)) {
      # Predict on test data (new sites - use population-level prediction)
      pred <- predict(model, newdata = test_data, re.form = NA)
      rmse_vals[k] <- sqrt(mean((test_data$TotalSpecies - pred)^2))
    } else {
      rmse_vals[k] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  return(rmse_vals)
}

# Compare models via CV
cat("Computing 10-fold CV RMSE (site-level folds)...\n\n")

cv_null <- cv_rmse(TotalSpecies ~ 1 + (1|Site), analysis_data)
cv_time <- cv_rmse(TotalSpecies ~ TimeSinceFire + (1|Site), analysis_data)
cv_type <- cv_rmse(TotalSpecies ~ TimeSinceFire + Type + (1|Site), analysis_data)
cv_interaction <- cv_rmse(TotalSpecies ~ TimeSinceFire * Type + (1|Site), analysis_data)

cat("Cross-Validation Results (RMSE):\n\n")
cv_results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Null (intercept only)", "Time only", "Time + Type", "Time * Type (interaction)"),
  Mean_RMSE = c(mean(cv_null, na.rm=TRUE), mean(cv_time, na.rm=TRUE), 
                mean(cv_type, na.rm=TRUE), mean(cv_interaction, na.rm=TRUE)),
  SD_RMSE = c(sd(cv_null, na.rm=TRUE), sd(cv_time, na.rm=TRUE),
              sd(cv_type, na.rm=TRUE), sd(cv_interaction, na.rm=TRUE))
)
cv_results$Mean_RMSE <- round(cv_results$Mean_RMSE, 2)
cv_results$SD_RMSE <- round(cv_results$SD_RMSE, 2)
print(cv_results)

cat("\nINTERPRETATION:\n")
cat("  - If interaction model has similar or higher RMSE than simpler models,\n")
cat("    this confirms the interaction term adds no predictive value.\n")
cat("  - This validates the null finding from p-value testing.\n\n")
```

```{r section9, echo=TRUE}
results_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = rownames(final_summary),
  Estimate = round(final_summary[, "Estimate"], 3),
  SE = round(final_summary[, "Std. Error"], 3),
  t_value = round(final_summary[, "t value"], 3),
  p_value = round(final_summary[, "Pr(>|t|)"], 3)
)
print(kable(results_table, format = "simple", row.names = FALSE))

cat("\n")
cat("RECOVERY RATES (from model coefficients):\n")
dry_rate <- final_coef["TimeSinceFire"]
wet_rate <- dry_rate + final_coef["TimeSinceFire:TypeWet"]
cat("  Dry sites:", round(dry_rate, 3), "species/year\n")
cat("  Wet sites:", round(wet_rate, 3), "species/year\n")
cat("  Difference:", round(wet_rate - dry_rate, 3), "species/year\n\n")

cat("VARIANCE EXPLAINED:\n")
r2 <- r.squaredGLMM(final_model)
cat("  Marginal R² (fixed effects only):", round(r2[1], 3), "\n")
cat("  Conditional R² (fixed + random):", round(r2[2], 3), "\n")
cat("  Interpretation: Fixed effects explain", round(r2[1]*100, 1), 
    "% of variance;\n")
cat("                  Adding site random effects explains", round(r2[2]*100, 1), "%\n\n")
```

## 10. REGULARISATION: LASSO AND RIDGE
```{r section10, echo=FALSE}

cat("10. REGULARISATION: LASSO AND RIDGE REGRESSION\n")


cat("RATIONALE:\n")
cat("  - LASSO (Tibshirani, 1996) performs variable selection via L1 penalty\n")
cat("  - Ridge regression handles multicollinearity via L2 penalty\n")
cat("  - Both use 10-fold cross-validation for optimal lambda selection\n\n")

set.seed(2025)

# Prepare data matrix
model_data <- analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::select(TotalSpecies, TimeSinceFire, Type, Fire_Cnt, 
                Dominant, Grassy, Aspect) %>%
  na.omit()

X <- model.matrix(TotalSpecies ~ TimeSinceFire + Type + Fire_Cnt + 
                    Dominant + Grassy + Aspect, 
                  data = model_data)[, -1]
y <- model_data$TotalSpecies

# Ridge Regression
cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 0, nfolds = 10)
cat("RIDGE REGRESSION (alpha = 0):\n")
cat("  Optimal lambda (min CV error):", round(cv_ridge$lambda.min, 4), "\n")
cat("  Lambda 1SE (more regularized):", round(cv_ridge$lambda.1se, 4), "\n\n")

# LASSO
cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 1, nfolds = 10)
cat("LASSO REGRESSION (alpha = 1):\n")
cat("  Optimal lambda (min CV error):", round(cv_lasso$lambda.min, 4), "\n")
cat("  Lambda 1SE (more regularized):", round(cv_lasso$lambda.1se, 4), "\n\n")

# LASSO coefficients at lambda.min
lasso_coef <- coef(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.min")
nonzero_idx <- which(lasso_coef != 0)
lasso_selected <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(lasso_coef)[nonzero_idx],
  Coefficient = round(as.numeric(lasso_coef[nonzero_idx]), 3)
)

cat("LASSO VARIABLE SELECTION (lambda.min):\n")
cat("  Variables retained:", length(nonzero_idx) - 1, "of", ncol(X), "\n\n")
print(kable(lasso_selected, format = "simple", row.names = FALSE))

# Check key variables
cat("\n")
# Check key variables - DYNAMICALLY
cat("\n")
cat("KEY FINDINGS:\n")
type_selected <- "TypeWet" %in% lasso_selected$Variable
time_selected <- "TimeSinceFire" %in% lasso_selected$Variable

if (type_selected) {
  type_coef <- lasso_selected$Coefficient[lasso_selected$Variable == "TypeWet"]
  cat("  - TypeWet RETAINED by LASSO (coef =", type_coef, ")\n")
} else {
  cat("  - TypeWet DROPPED by LASSO - no predictive value beyond other variables\n")
}

if (time_selected) {
  time_coef <- lasso_selected$Coefficient[lasso_selected$Variable == "TimeSinceFire"]
  cat("  - TimeSinceFire RETAINED by LASSO (coef =", time_coef, ")\n")
} else {
  cat("  - TimeSinceFire DROPPED by LASSO\n")
}

cat("\n")
cat("INTERPRETATION:\n")
cat("  LASSO confirms that Type adds no predictive value when other variables\n")
cat("  (Fire_Cnt, Dominant, Grassy) are included. This validates the null finding\n")
cat("  from mixed models - the Type effect is absorbed by other site characteristics.\n\n")

```

```{r section10.1, echo=FALSE}

# Plot CV curves
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(cv_ridge, main = "Ridge: Cross-Validation Curve")
abline(v = log(cv_ridge$lambda.min), col = "red", lty = 2)
plot(cv_lasso, main = "LASSO: Cross-Validation Curve")
abline(v = log(cv_lasso$lambda.min), col = "red", lty = 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```


## 11. DECISION TREE & VARIABLE IMPORTANCE

```{r section11, echo=FALSE}

cat("11. DECISION TREE: VARIABLE IMPORTANCE\n")

cat("RATIONALE:\n")
cat("  - Non-parametric method complements linear models\n")
cat("  - Variable importance shows predictive contribution\n")
cat("  - Tree structure reveals interaction patterns\n\n")

tree_model <- rpart(
  TotalSpecies ~ TimeSinceFire + Type + Fire_Cnt + Dominant + Grassy + Aspect,
  data = analysis_data,
  method = "anova",
  control = rpart.control(minsplit = 10, cp = 0.01)
)

# Variable importance
if (length(tree_model$variable.importance) > 0) {
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(tree_model$variable.importance),
    Importance = round(tree_model$variable.importance, 2)
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
    mutate(Rank = row_number())
  
  cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE RANKING:\n\n")
  print(kable(importance_df, format = "simple", row.names = FALSE))
  
  # Find Type rank
  type_rank <- importance_df$Rank[importance_df$Variable == "Type"]
  cat("\n")
  cat("KEY FINDING:\n")
  cat("  Type ranks #", type_rank, " out of ", nrow(importance_df), " predictors\n", sep = "")
  
  if (type_rank <= 2) {
    cat("  Type IS an important predictor of species richness\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("  Type is NOT among the top predictors\n")
    cat("  This aligns with the non-significant interaction finding\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("  No splits made - tree could not find useful predictors\n\n")
}
```

```{r section11.1, echo=FALSE}
# Plot the tree
rpart.plot(tree_model, 
           main = "Decision Tree: Predicting Species Richness",
           extra = 101,
           box.palette = "GnBu",
           shadow.col = "gray",
           nn = TRUE)
```


## 12. SYSTEMATIC CONFOUNDING ANALYSIS


```{r section12, echo=TRUE}

cat("12. CONFOUNDING ANALYSIS: Chi-Squared Tests\n")

cat("RATIONALE:\n")
cat("  A confounder must be associated with BOTH the exposure (Type) AND outcome.\n")
cat("  We test association with Type using chi-squared (categorical) or t-test (continuous).\n\n")

# Chi-squared tests
grassy_test <- chisq.test(table(analysis_data$Type, analysis_data$Grassy))
dominant_test <- chisq.test(table(analysis_data$Type, analysis_data$Dominant))
aspect_test <- chisq.test(table(analysis_data$Type, analysis_data$Aspect))
fire_ttest <- t.test(Fire_Cnt ~ Type, data = analysis_data)

# Summary table
confounding_results <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("Dominant Species", "Aspect", "Grassy", "Fire Count"),
  Test = c("Chi-squared", "Chi-squared", "Chi-squared", "t-test"),
  Statistic = c(
    round(dominant_test$statistic, 2),
    round(aspect_test$statistic, 2),
    round(grassy_test$statistic, 2),
    round(fire_ttest$statistic, 2)
  ),
  p_value = c(
    dominant_test$p.value,
    aspect_test$p.value,
    grassy_test$p.value,
    fire_ttest$p.value
  )
)

confounding_results <- confounding_results %>%
  mutate(
    Significant = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
    p_value = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_value, 3)),
    Status = ifelse(Significant == "Yes", "POTENTIAL CONFOUNDER", "Independent of Type")
  )

cat("ASSOCIATION WITH TYPE (Exposure Variable):\n\n")
print(kable(confounding_results, format = "simple", row.names = FALSE))

cat("\n")
cat("INTERPRETATION:\n")
n_confounders <- sum(confounding_results$Significant == "Yes")
cat("  -", n_confounders, "variables are significantly associated with Type\n")
cat("  - These are POTENTIAL confounders if also associated with TotalSpecies\n")
cat("  - Section 4.D showed adjusting for Dominant changed estimate by only 1%\n")
cat("  - Confounding does NOT explain the null finding\n\n")
```

## 14. FINAL CONCLUSIONS

```{r section14, echo=TRUE}
cat("14. FINAL CONCLUSIONS\n")

cat("RESEARCH QUESTION:\n")
cat("  Do sites classified as wet show faster species recovery than sites\n")
cat("  classified as dry after bushfires?\n\n")

cat("PRIMARY FINDING:\n")
cat("  The interaction term (TimeSinceFire × Type) was NOT significant\n")
cat("  (p = ", round(p_interaction, 3), "), meaning we cannot conclude that\n", sep = "")
cat("  wet sites recover at a different rate than dry sites.\n\n")

cat("HOWEVER, this null finding must be interpreted cautiously:\n\n")

cat("1. POWER LIMITATION:\n")
cat("   - Only ", n_distinct(analysis_data$Site), " sites with ICC = ", 
    round(icc_gauss, 2), "\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Minimum detectable effect: ", round(mde, 2), " species/year\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Observed effect (", round(interaction_estimate, 2), 
    ") smaller than MDE\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Study was UNDERPOWERED to detect the observed effect size\n\n")

cat("2. GAM REVEALS NUANCED PATTERN:\n")
cat("   - Wet sites: Significant time effect (p = ", round(p_wet_smooth, 3), ")\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Dry sites: No significant time effect (p = ", round(p_dry_smooth, 3), ")\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Recovery IS occurring in wet sites but NOT detectable in dry sites\n")
cat("   - The interaction test asks if slopes DIFFER, not if each differs from zero\n\n")

cat("3. HETEROGENEITY:\n")
cat("   - Random slopes significantly improve fit (LRT p = ", round(lrt_pvalue, 3), ")\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Sites within each type recover at DIFFERENT rates\n")
cat("   - 95% of sites: ", round(time_effect - 1.96*slope_sd, 2), " to ", 
    round(time_effect + 1.96*slope_sd, 2), " species/year\n", sep = "")
cat("   - This heterogeneity reduces power to detect average differences\n\n")

cat("4. ROBUSTNESS:\n")
cat("   - Null finding persists in common time window (p = ", round(common_p, 3), ")\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Adjusting for Dominant species changed estimate by only ", 
    round(est_change, 1), "%\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Cross-validation confirms interaction adds no predictive value\n\n")

cat("FINAL INTERPRETATION:\n")
cat("  This is an UNINFORMATIVE NULL - we cannot conclude that recovery rates\n")
cat("  are equal, only that the available data are insufficient to detect a\n")
cat("  difference. The GAM finding suggests wet sites DO show recovery while\n")
cat("  dry sites do not, but we lack power to confirm the differential rate.\n\n")

cat("RECOMMENDATIONS:\n")
cat("  1. Longer monitoring of dry sites (currently max 5.1 years vs 15.2 for wet)\n")
cat("  2. Increased sample size (more sites per type)\n")
cat("  3. More frequent visits to reduce within-site variance\n")
cat("  4. Consider site-level predictors that explain heterogeneity\n\n")
```

```{r section15, echo=TRUE}
cat("INTERPRETATION:\n\n")

cat("The research question asked whether wet sites recover faster than dry sites.\n")
cat("Our analysis reveals a more nuanced answer:\n\n")

cat("1. WET SITES SHOW SIGNIFICANT RECOVERY (GAM p=0.004)\n")
cat("   - Species richness increases over time in wet sites\n")
cat("   - Rate: approximately 0.57 species/year\n\n")

cat("2. DRY SITES SHOW NO DETECTABLE RECOVERY (GAM p=0.563)\n")
cat("   - No significant temporal trend in dry sites\n")
cat("   - Rate: approximately 0.14 species/year (not different from zero)\n\n")

cat("3. THE INTERACTION IS NOT SIGNIFICANT (p=0.184)\n")
cat("   - We cannot statistically confirm the DIFFERENCE in slopes\n")
cat("   - This is a power limitation, not evidence of equal rates\n\n")

cat("4. TYPE EFFECT IS MEDIATED BY SITE CHARACTERISTICS\n")
cat("   - Decision tree: Type ranks 5th in importance\n")
cat("   - LASSO: Type dropped when other variables included\n")
cat("   - Fire history (Fire_Cnt) and Dominant species explain more variance\n\n")

cat("PRACTICAL CONCLUSION:\n")
cat("  Wet sites are recovering; dry sites are not. However, the 'wet vs dry'\n")
cat("  classification may be a proxy for underlying differences in fire history\n")
cat("  and vegetation composition rather than a direct causal factor.\n\n")
```

```{r slideicc, echo=FALSE}
icc_slide <- data.frame(
  Component = c("Between Sites\n(60%)", "Within Sites\n(40%)"),
  Percentage = c(60, 40)
)

p_icc <- ggplot(icc_slide, aes(x = "", y = Percentage, fill = Component)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 2) +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1a9988", "#2c5aa0")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Percentage, "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), 
            size = 10, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  labs(
    title = "Where Does the Variance Come From?",
    subtitle = "60% of variation is between sites, not over time"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
print(p_icc)
ggsave("figures/slide_icc.png", p_icc, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r slide5, echo=FALSE}
# Create the definitive recovery trajectories slide
p_recovery_slide <- ggplot() +
  # Confidence ribbons
  geom_ribbon(data = gam_pred_all, 
              aes(x = TimeSinceFire, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = Type),
              alpha = 0.25) +
  # Trajectory lines
  geom_line(data = gam_pred_all, 
            aes(x = TimeSinceFire, y = fit, color = Type), 
            linewidth = 1.5) +
  # Raw data points (subtle)
  geom_point(data = analysis_data, 
             aes(x = TimeSinceFire, y = TotalSpecies, color = Type), 
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
  # Fire event line
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 1) +
  # Annotations
  annotate("text", x = 12, y = 50, label = "Wet: 0.56 species/year\np = 0.004", 
           color = "#1a9988", size = 5, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 3, y = 28, label = "Dry: 0.14 species/year\np = 0.563", 
           color = "#2c5aa0", size = 5, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Dry" = "#2c5aa0", "Wet" = "#1a9988")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dry" = "#2c5aa0", "Wet" = "#1a9988")) +
  labs(
    title = "Species Recovery Trajectories",

    y = "Total Species Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),

  )
```

```{r slide9, echo=FALSE}
# LASSO + Decision Tree comparison slide
# Left panel: LASSO coefficients
lasso_slide_data <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("Fire_Cnt", "Grassy_S", "TimeSinceFire", "Dominant_Peppermint", "TypeWet"),
  Coefficient = c(2.5, -5.2, 0.3, -3.1, 0),  # Use your actual values
  Retained = c("Yes", "Yes", "Yes", "Yes", "DROPPED")
)

p_lasso_slide <- ggplot(lasso_slide_data, aes(x = reorder(Variable, abs(Coefficient)), 
                                               y = Coefficient, 
                                               fill = Retained)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "#1a9988", "DROPPED" = "#d9534f")) +
  labs(
    title = "LASSO Variable Selection",
    subtitle = "TypeWet shrunk to ZERO",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Coefficient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Right panel: Decision Tree importance
tree_slide_data <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("Fire_Cnt", "Dominant", "TimeSinceFire", "Grassy", "Type"),
  Importance = c(6059, 3659, 2891, 1867, 1465),
  Rank = 1:5
)

p_tree_slide <- ggplot(tree_slide_data, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), 
                                             y = Importance,
                                             fill = Variable == "Type")) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#d9534f", "FALSE" = "#2c5aa0")) +
  labs(
    title = "Decision Tree Importance",
    subtitle = "Type ranks 5th of 5",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Importance Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Combine
p_ml_convergence <- p_lasso_slide + p_tree_slide +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Machine Learning Convergence: Both Methods Drop 'Type'",
    subtitle = "The wet/dry label is a proxy for Fire History and Dominant Species",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
    )
  )

ggsave("figures/slide_ml_convergence.png", p_ml_convergence, width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r slide11, echo=FALSE}
# The "uninformative null" visualization
null_slide_data <- data.frame(
  Type = factor(c("Dry Sites", "Wet Sites"), levels = c("Dry Sites", "Wet Sites")),
  Rate = c(0.14, 0.56),
  SE = c(0.15, 0.14)  # Approximate from your model
)

p_null_slide <- ggplot(null_slide_data, aes(x = Type, y = Rate, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Rate - 1.96*SE, ymax = Rate + 1.96*SE), 
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Rate, " sp/yr")), vjust = -2, size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dry Sites" = "#2c5aa0", "Wet Sites" = "#1a9988")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.3, 1.0)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.85, 
           label = "4x difference\nbut CIs overlap zero", 
           size = 5, color = "grey30") +
  labs(
    title = "The Uninformative Null",
    subtitle = "p = 0.18 reflects insufficient data, not equal recovery rates",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Recovery Rate (species/year)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave("figures/slide_uninformative_null.png", p_null_slide, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r slidegam, echo=FALSE}
# GAM Linearity Check - Combined Visual with Interpretation 
library(patchwork)

# Panel A: EDF Comparison
edf_slide_data <- data.frame(
  Type = factor(c("Dry Sites", "Wet Sites"), levels = c("Dry Sites", "Wet Sites")),
  EDF = c(edf_dry, edf_wet),
  p_value = c(p_dry_smooth, p_wet_smooth)
)

p_edf_bars <- ggplot(edf_slide_data, aes(x = Type, y = EDF, fill = Type)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#0d5c52", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(EDF, 2)), vjust = -0.5, size = 8, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dry Sites" = "#2c5aa0", "Wet Sites" = "#1a9988")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.4)) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Effective Degrees of Freedom",
    subtitle = "EDF = 1 means straight line (dashed line)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "EDF"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

# Panel B: Time Effect Significance - FIXED annotation position
p_significance <- ggplot(edf_slide_data, aes(x = Type, y = -log10(p_value), fill = Type)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "#d9534f", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("p = ", round(p_value, 3))), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 2.15, y = -log10(0.05) + 0.25,   # Moved x from 2.45 to 2.15
           label = "α = 0.05", size = 4, color = "#d9534f", hjust = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dry Sites" = "#2c5aa0", "Wet Sites" = "#1a9988")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3.5)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "B. Time Effect Significance",
    subtitle = "Above dashed line = significant",
    x = NULL,
    y = "-log₁₀(p-value)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 15, 5, 5)  # Added right margin
  )

# Panel C: Interpretation box - CORRECTED with 4 colors
interpretation_data <- data.frame(
  x = 1,
  y = c(4, 3, 2, 1),
  text = c(
    "EDF ≈ 1.0 for both → Straight lines, not curves",
    "This validates reporting the simpler Mixed Model",
    "Wet sites: Significant UPWARD slope (p = 0.004)",
    "Dry sites: Flat slope, no recovery detected (p = 0.563)"
  )
)

p_interpretation <- ggplot(interpretation_data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = text), hjust = 0, size = 5, 
            color = c("#0d5c52", "#0d5c52", "#1a9988", "#2c5aa0"),
            fontface = "bold") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.9, 3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 4.5)) +
  labs(title = "C. Key Findings") +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8f9fa", color = "#dee2e6", linewidth = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

# Combine all panels
fig_gam_linearity_slide <- (p_edf_bars | p_significance) / p_interpretation +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.2, 0.6)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "GAM Diagnostic: Testing for Non-Linear Recovery",
    subtitle = "Straight-line relationships validated → Justifies reporting simpler Gaussian Mixed Model",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30")
    )
  )

print(fig_gam_linearity_slide)
ggsave("figures/slide_7_gam_linearity_combined.png", fig_gam_linearity_slide, 
       width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
